name: seed-permitted
description: The differential baseline. One authorized seed selector, a complete valid unexpired S2 record, a manifest declaring its bystanders with an in-set disposition, and an incidental estimate on the pre-flight record. SS-5's three mutations are this row with one field changed, and SS-8 step 3's matched pair has a permitted half for the same reason. Held because the stamp state is fixture-supplied and because step 6 has no manifest schema to read.

expect_decision.render: The run proceeds. The runner will construct argv, and that is the whole of what this value means.

authorization.purpose: Measure the matcher against the designed cast, scoring the confuser pair as known negatives.

name: one-hop-permitted
description: A pivot one hop from the seed, on an email extracted from the seed run. The selector is outside the record's selectors and inside pivot_depth_max, so step 4's second disjunct carries it. Depth 1 against a bound of 2 is strictly inside under either reading of the bound, which is why the row does not sit on the boundary. Held on GF-U6 because what separates this permitted pivot from a drifted chain is the predicate nothing states.

expect_decision.render: The run proceeds. The runner will construct argv, and that is the whole of what this value means.

authorization.purpose: Measure the matcher against the designed cast, scoring the confuser pair as known negatives.

name: seed-selectors-mutated
description: seed-permitted with one field changed: the record authorizes a different persona's handle, so the dispatched seed is outside the authorized set. A seed carries no chain to an authorized selector, so step 4's second disjunct is unavailable to it and the basis is selector_outside_set. This is the first of SS-5's three mandated one-field mutations, and the field it proves is read is selectors.

expect_decision.render: REFUSED PENDING AUTHORIZATION. This selector is outside the case authorization. The run did not execute and nothing was collected. Extend the authorization, narrow the pivot, or drop it.

authorization.purpose: Measure the matcher against the designed cast, scoring the confuser pair as known negatives.

name: one-hop-pivot-depth-max-mutated
description: one-hop-permitted with one field changed: pivot_depth_max is 0, so the record authorizes its seeds only and the chain may not walk. The second of SS-5's three mutations, applied to the one-hop row rather than to the seed row because a depth bound is not load-bearing on a seed: SS-4 reads 0 as the record authorizing its seeds, so mutating the seed row's bound to 0 would still permit.

expect_decision.render: REFUSED PENDING AUTHORIZATION. This selector is outside the case authorization. The run did not execute and nothing was collected. Extend the authorization, narrow the pivot, or drop it.

authorization.purpose: Measure the matcher against the designed cast, scoring the confuser pair as known negatives.

name: seed-expires-on-mutated
description: seed-permitted with one field changed: expires_on precedes evaluated_at, so the record no longer authorizes anything. The third of SS-5's three mutations, and the one the criterion exists for: in the precedent guard expires_on did not exist at all, so no authorization could expire. The row is four days clear of the expiry, so it refuses under either reading of the comparison SA-U3 holds. Held on SA-U1 because the only consequence sentence doctrine supplies for REFUSED says no authorization file unlocks it, and a renewal unlocks this one.

authorization.purpose: Measure the matcher against the designed cast, scoring the confuser pair as known negatives.

name: expiry-boundary-same-day
description: seed-permitted with expires_on equal to the date of evaluated_at. The row asserts nothing: whether the record authorizes the dispatch on its expiry date is inclusivity, and SA-U3 holds inclusivity, the clock, and whether the comparison re-runs for a run already in flight. A corpus that guessed here would decide how long collection may continue.

authorization.purpose: Measure the matcher against the designed cast, scoring the confuser pair as known negatives.

name: depth-at-the-limit
description: A pivot whose depth from the seed equals pivot_depth_max. The row asserts nothing: section 9 says a chain that reaches the limit returns requires_extension and does not say whether a chain at the bound has reached it, and the two readings differ by one hop of reach. GF-U6 holds it. The shipped must-pass corpus carries a pivot at depth 3 against a bound of 3 with basis pivot_depth_exceeded, which is precedent rather than doctrine and is recorded here rather than relied on.

authorization.purpose: Measure the matcher against the designed cast, scoring the confuser pair as known negatives.

name: never-item-6-artifacts-unstamped
description: A complete, valid, unexpired authorization record, refused under a named NEVER item. The stamp state is read from the live pin of record, where no artifact carries a row, so item 6 refuses and a present authorization file does not unlock it. This row and criterion-absent-from-stamp-table are the two candidate answers to GF-U1, carried together so the stamped answer deletes one of them. This one inverts to permitted on the day the operator stamps the eight artifacts, which is the cost GF-U1 records.

expect_decision.render:
REFUSED
  where: the dispatch path, before argv and before a credential is drawn
  what:  SS-14 item 6 refuses all collection, including collection against
         a synthetic account, until all eight artifacts above carry a dated
         stamp in doctrine/DOCTRINE_STATUS.md and preflight has passed in
         this runner process. This is a hard refusal, so a present,
         complete, valid, unexpired authorization record does not unlock it
  moves: stamp the artifacts that are missing a row, in the pin of record,
         dated and with a ratifier; or run the four preflight checks and
         fix what they refuse; or collect nothing, which is what this
         refusal is holding

An unratified criterion refuses rather than permits, which is the sentence the pin of record opens with and the check Step 8's done-condition names. The refusal surfaces as NEVER item 6 because item 6 is the only stamp-reading mechanism the gate has, which is GF-R8 rather than a doctrine sentence.

name: run-against-unauthorized-subject
description: A PROBE_EVENT RUN_START with no COLLECT_EVENT PERMITTED parent: a run that reached a platform without passing the gate at all. The row asserts a code rather than a gate value, because the gate returned none, and that absence is the defect. The name, the code and expect_only are reserved for this corpus by spec/layer-model.yaml's fixture map and are not the fixture author's to choose. The expected code rests on S7-R7, a generator reading recorded as awaiting confirmation rather than as a decision.

authorization.purpose: Measure the matcher against the designed cast, scoring the confuser pair as known negatives.

name: run-without-purpose-binding
description: A dispatch whose record and whose GRANT carry no purpose. SS-4 binds the purpose to the case at creation and refuses a partial record, and rank 3 requires a PERMITTED decision to resolve its authorization_ref to a GRANT carrying purpose_hash. The name, the code and expect_only are reserved for this corpus by the fixture map. The step is held: SS-8's six-step order does not place purpose_unbound, which GF-U3 carries.

name: bystander-disposition-retain
description: The connector manifest declares a bystander disposition of retain. The disposition vocabulary is closed at v0.1 to count_only and refuse, and a value outside the closed set is refused rather than defaulted. The permitted half of this pair is seed-permitted, which declares refuse and clears step 6, so the corpus carries the pair SS-8's standard asks for without a second permitted row. This row exercises the gate's step 6 check; the manifest-validation locus SS-10 names is Step 12's and is a separate refusal on the same fact.

authorization.purpose: Measure the matcher against the designed cast, scoring the confuser pair as known negatives.

name: bystander-declaration-absent
description: The connector declares nothing about what it reaches beyond its named selector. SS-8 step 6 requires the declaration to be present, and SS-10 refuses an undeclared bystander class at manifest validation rather than flagging it. Held on SA-U9: with no connector-manifest schema in existence, whether the absence of a declaration refuses or passes until Step 12 is the same question that holds every dispatch.

authorization.purpose: Measure the matcher against the designed cast, scoring the confuser pair as known negatives.

name: incidental-estimate-absent
description: The pre-flight record carries no incidental-count estimate and no reason. SS-12 makes the estimate required and says a blank field is a refusal, which is the whole criterion. Held on SA-U13, because what makes a pivot reach beyond its named selector is a manifest fact settled at Step 12 and the requirement has no trigger until then, and on SA-U16, because SS-8's six steps do not contain the pre-flight read and the wire requires a step.

authorization.purpose: Measure the matcher against the designed cast, scoring the confuser pair as known negatives.

name: incidental-selector-dispatched-as-seed
description: A person whose data arrived as a byproduct of a channel collection is added to the same case's record and dispatched as a seed. The chain's origin resolves to a COLLECT_EVENT whose subject_relation is incidental, and an S5 selector is not a seed for anything. The refusal keys on the per-case relation the runner computed, never on the selector value, and promotion requires that person's own record in a new case. Held on GF-U2: refusal_basis has no member for an incidental chain origin and a REFUSED payload requires one.

authorization.purpose: Measure the matcher against the designed cast, scoring the confuser pair as known negatives.

name: injected-instruction-in-collected-bio
description: A collected bio carries a plausible instruction to collect on a second selector, and the dispatch on that selector is stopped. The instruction is cited as payload family PF-1 and no payload string appears in this file: the operator composes the text at account creation from the shape the cast names. subject_guard.evaluate() reads the authorization record and the pivot chain and never the content of a collected field, so the row asserts the same decision the identical chain without the payload gets. SS-19's word refuses is the stopped run, which is the middle value here: SS-7 says the middle value stops the run.

expect_decision.render: REFUSED PENDING AUTHORIZATION. This selector is outside the case authorization. The run did not execute and nothing was collected. Extend the authorization, narrow the pivot, or drop it.

authorization.purpose: Measure the matcher against the designed cast, scoring the confuser pair as known negatives.

name: injected-instruction-absent
description: The matched pair for injected-instruction-in-collected-bio: the identical chain with no payload family present, asserting the identical decision. One refusing fixture proves only that something refused. The pair proves the gate is not reading the collected field, which is the property SS-19 states. Doctrine names one fixture here and this second row is a permitted strengthening rather than a replacement for it.

expect_decision.render: REFUSED PENDING AUTHORIZATION. This selector is outside the case authorization. The run did not execute and nothing was collected. Extend the authorization, narrow the pivot, or drop it.

authorization.purpose: Measure the matcher against the designed cast, scoring the confuser pair as known negatives.

name: runner-started-on-local
description: A runner started on LOCAL with a live connector manifest. Every run records the environment it executed from, and a run from the wrong environment is refused rather than logged, because a run that already reached a platform cannot be un-run. The row asserts a code rather than a gate value: preflight refuses at runner startup, before the gate sees the dispatch, and refusal_basis carries no member for an environment. Naming a value here would claim the gate decided something it never saw.

authorization.purpose: Measure the matcher against the designed cast, scoring the confuser pair as known negatives.

name: scope-drift-three-hops
description: Three hops, each individually legal, composing onto a selector nobody authorized. The record authorizes one handle at a depth bound of 4, so no hop exceeds the bound and no hop is refused on its own. The composition walks handle to email to phone to a second persona's handle, and the second persona is the cast's designed confuser: the near-miss a naive matcher fires on. A gate that evaluates only the current hop passes all three. The name, the code and expect_only are reserved for this corpus by spec/layer-model.yaml's fixture map. Held on GF-U6, which is the predicate that makes this chain drifted and the one-hop row permitted.

expect_decision.render: REFUSED PENDING AUTHORIZATION. This selector is outside the case authorization. The run did not execute and nothing was collected. Extend the authorization, narrow the pivot, or drop it.

authorization.purpose: Measure the matcher against the designed cast, scoring the confuser pair as known negatives.

name: s4-baseline-scorecard-absent
description: One authorization record declaring subject_class S4, with no baseline scorecard on file. SS-17 refuses an S3 or S4 run until at least one scorecard exists against a class where precision and recall are computable, and this row is the enforcement point at step 3. Held on SA-U6 and SA-U7, because there is no object to look for and no artifact for the dated override, and on SA-U2, because S4's evidence is a written statement and SS-4's evidence_ref names three objects, none of which is one.

authorization.purpose: Measure the matcher against a subject authorized under a written statement, scored against the cast.

name: s4-baseline-scorecard-present
description: The permitted half of the same pair: the identical record with a baseline scorecard on file. A single fixture proves only that something refuses; the pair proves the gate is reading the condition and not the weather. Held on the same entries as its partner, plus SA-U9.

expect_decision.render: The run proceeds. The runner will construct argv, and that is the whole of what this value means.

authorization.purpose: Measure the matcher against a subject authorized under a written statement, scored against the cast.
